name: honk-hoon
description: Hoon diagnostics powered directly by the honk compiler

honk.server.path.description: Path to the honk-lsp executable. Empty searches this repository's target directories, then PATH.

honk.preludePath.description: Compiler prelude path. Relative paths and ${workspaceFolder} are resolved against the workspace.

honk.dependenciesPath.description: Hoon dependency root. Defaults to <workspace>/hoon when available.

honk.entryPath.description: Optional stable entry to check whenever any open Hoon document changes.

honk.subjectTypeJamPath.description: Optional precompiled subject type jam passed to honk.

honk.checkDelayMilliseconds.description: Quiet period before checking the latest editor state.

honk.maxChecks.description: Checks before rotating compiler state. Zero disables rotation.

honk.workerStackBytes.description: Native compiler worker stack size in bytes.

honk.codeLens.references.description: Show a reference count above every arm and mold. Click it to open the references peek.

enumDescriptions: Only when the lens adds something the lines under the header do not: a sample or product spanning several lines or pushed down by comments, or a product the source leaves implicit that the compiler could infer.
Above every gate, door, and trap arm.
honk.codeLens.signatures.description: When to show the sample and product of an arm above its header, read from the |= and ^- runes that open it.

enumDescriptions: The runes as written: |=  sample  ^-  product
honk.codeLens.signatureStyle.description: How a signature lens is rendered.

honk.codeLens.inferredTypes.description: When an arm does not write its product with ^-, fill it in from the compiler's inferred type if that type is concrete (atoms, cells, nouns). Lazy types such as gate calls and lists stay omitted.

honk.codeLens.signatureMaxLength.description: Longest signature lens before it is truncated with an ellipsis.
